description: Forward a message to new recipients as a fresh thread, quoting the original and re-attaching its files, and return the created message. Useful for handing a conversation to a human. Errors: 404 unknown message, 402 plan send limit reached.

client_id.description: Optional idempotency key; a repeat with the same client_id does not forward twice.

from_inbox_id.description: Optional inbox to send from. Defaults to the inbox that received the original.

message_id.description: Id of the message to forward.

text.description: Optional note placed above the quoted original.

to.description: Recipient email addresses; at least one.

name: forward_message
title: Forward email
